claim: For categorical outcomes the Brier, logarithmic and spherical rules are proper; the multi-class Brier score is bounded while the logarithmic score is unbounded on a confident miss.
title: Proper scoring rules for estimation and forecast evaluation

claim: In a prediction tournament the winner may be far from the best forecaster, because the luck of which questions are asked and how they resolve can dominate skill differences.
title: A Prediction Tournament Paradox

claim: A Markov decision process can choose which level segment to generate next so that a platformer's difficulty adjusts to the player's observed performance.
title: Dynamic Difficulty Adjustment via Procedural Level Generation Guided by a Markov Decision Process for Platformers
